name: 糖原病Ia型

sources.title: Glycogen storage disease due to glucose-6-phosphatase deficiency

summary.text: A rare inherited metabolic disease (comprising two major subtypes: type Ia and Ib) characterized by poor tolerance to fasting, growth delay and hepatomegaly resulting from accumulation of glycogen and fat in the liver.
